instruction: Set the text box width to 18cm on slide 1, 30cm on slide 2, and 15cm on slide 5.
hint: The input unit is cm. Modify the first text box on each slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

Slide 1 has 3 auto shapes (first one at 13.43cm width, target 18cm), Slide 2 has 7 auto shapes (first one at 26.07cm, target 30cm), Slide 5 has 7 auto shapes (first one at 11.45cm, target 15cm). Custom getter extracts actual shape widths from the modified file, and metric compares against expected values with 0.5cm tolerance.
metadata.verification: Checked actual text box dimensions on slides 1, 2, 5: slide 1 first shape is 13.43cm wide, slide 2 first shape is 26.07cm wide, slide 5 first shape is 11.45cm wide. Target widths are feasible modifications.
